why: A caller passes arguments by position, so the signature is compared by position and never by parameter name. Lookup.fetch: the unused optional parameter region became _region; the same signature, proved. total: both parameters renamed and the body renamed with them, its loop too; the same function up to a renaming of bound names, proved. bump: a heap-core unit renamed the same way; its hypothesis names the parameters and is compared by position, proved. diff: the two names swapped over an unchanged body, so the function now subtracts the other way; the signature agrees, the lemma is not proved, lane B finds the witness. width: renamed and its parameter type number | undefined became number | null; withheld as an interface change naming parameter 1's type. Routes.close: renamed and its parameter decorator changed; withheld naming parameter 1's decorators. Routes.open: untouched, proved.
